question: Can Demis's automatic prestige conversion and Jensen's unconditional architecture allocation be reduced without weakening Demis's science or Jensen's supplier transactions?

demis.protectedStrength: Starting Compute, Scientific Method reliability, every Research decision, and all Capability remain unchanged.
demis.bottleneck: A five-domain run still earns Trust, but Nobel Effect grants one Trust instead of two.
demis.eligibility: Reject the candidate if it suppresses Research selection, Scientific Method use, five-domain runs, or Capability rather than reducing automatic public prestige.

foundry.protectedStrength: Four starting Compute, every rival license offer, every accepted sale, all licensing revenue, and a three-Compute ceiling remain.
foundry.bottleneck: New Architecture grants Jensen one self-Compute per accepted rival license and no unconditional base Compute.
foundry.eligibility: Reject the candidate if it suppresses offers or sales, makes rival demand irrelevant, or overcorrects three-player Foundry where only two rival licenses exist.

requiredDiagnostics: configuration-specific faction win share, mean Mandate, and mean rank by player count
Nobel Effect uses, Trust gained, qualifying Capability, Scientific Method uses, Capability preserved, and Research selections
New Architecture self Compute, licenses sold, rival Compute granted, Runway gained, and Foundry action selection
paired faction win-share, score, and rank delta
forced no-ops, policy fallbacks, and integrity violations

selectionRule.demis: Select only if Demis moves materially toward four-player parity, remains competitive at three and five, and retains canonical Research, Scientific Method, and Capability realization.
selectionRule.foundry: Select only if Foundry moves toward parity at four and five without falling materially below parity at three, while license offers, sales, revenue, and rival Compute remain intact.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare each candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Positive paired rankDelta means improved placement.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, missing configuration-specific faction standing, or missing realized-ability accounting rejects the probe.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical text changes without a tracked receipt, complete surface audit, a new immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
